user_feedback_from_v7_2.engine: Needs substantially more engine growl/roar; V7.2 still sounds like a Famicom/retro-game sound.
user_feedback_from_v7_2.tire: Needs a much clearer tire squeal / kyuru-kyuru friction sound.
user_feedback_from_v7_2.recording: User is currently moving and could not make a new recording; recording is not required for this gate.

engine: Replaced short regular-feeling combustion texture with a 2.6s jittered combustion-event buffer.
Added separate broadband low/mid engine roar layer.
Added body resonance, dynamic low-pass shaping and gentle soft clipping.
Reduced dependence on playback-rate pitch sweep; rev impression now also comes from gain/filter/load changes.
tire: Built tire squeal from filtered broadband noise rather than a pitched oscillator.
Parallel moderate-Q friction bands around low-mid and high squeal regions plus high-frequency air texture.
Snap phase drives the strongest squeal; launch and exit receive shorter chirp-like friction bursts.
Filter centers move during snap to avoid static hiss while remaining noise-based.

browser_proof.caveat: Browser proof verifies signal, phase targeting, and no motion/skid regression. It does not prove perceived realism on physical iPhone speakers.

review_instruction: Listen on the iPhone first. A new recording is helpful later if the sound is still wrong, but is not required before giving the next feel judgment.
